headline: SpaceX's Starfall capsule is back in orbit, Nvidia ships new open agent models, ID@Xbox brings a Wolf Among Us remaster, and it's fight week for UFC 333 and Austin.

upcoming.what: Orionid meteor shower peaks overnight; best after midnight, moonlight permitting
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2 and PC
UFC 333, Abu Dhabi: Volkanovski vs Evloev, Yan vs Dvalishvili 3. Main card 19:00 Irish time
F1 United States GP, Austin (standard format). FP1 Fri 17:30, Quali Sat 22:00, race Sun 20:00 Irish time (clocks go back Sunday morning)
The Wolf Among Us Remastered launches digitally on Xbox
IBJJF The Crown, Long Beach: invitation-only, eight-athlete brackets

items.headline: Nvidia launches Nemotron 3.5 open models for agents
items.summary: The 120B-parameter Nemotron 3.5 Super VL targets enterprise agents, and two smaller 'Bolt' models are built to run locally on RTX AI PCs and DGX Spark. Salesforce, EY and CrowdStrike are named as early customers.

items.headline: AI labs build their own rulebook as Washington steps back
items.summary: Anthropic, OpenAI and Google are putting together a voluntary self-policing system, while also debating how to share the wealth AI may create. The White House still insists on mandatory incident reporting.

items.headline: Why the Anthropic–Nscale talks matter for Nvidia
items.summary: This follows up yesterday's report of a possible ~$45bn compute deal: the capacity would mean a large order of Nvidia hardware. Nothing has been signed yet.

items.headline: Bandwagon-5 launches: SpaceX's Starfall capsule flies again
items.summary: After Monday's weather scrub, Falcon 9 got away from Cape Canaveral on Tuesday with 31 customer payloads. It also carried the second flight of Starfall, SpaceX's uncrewed reentry capsule that brings experiments back to Earth.

items.headline: Orionids peak tonight
items.summary: Halley's Comet debris peaks tonight into tomorrow morning. With clear Irish skies, look east to south-east after midnight for up to roughly 20 meteors an hour.

items.headline: ID@Xbox showcase: Wolf Among Us remaster and Shrek 2
items.summary: The Wolf Among Us Remastered arrives digitally on 29 October, and Shrek 2 Remastered on 10 November. Also shown: ZERO PARADES: Director's Cut on 3 November, plus the co-op A Game About Digging A Hole Together on Game Pass on 4 December.

items.headline: Modern Warfare 4 arrives Friday; watchlist quiet
items.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches on Friday. There's nothing new on The Witcher 4, Cyberpunk 2, Witcher 3 or Borderlands since yesterday.

items.headline: Quiet week; The Crown and Tsarukyan vs Neiman Gracie ahead
items.summary: No major pro grappling results today. Next up are IBJJF's The Crown on 8 November, then Arman Tsarukyan against Neiman Gracie at RAF Abu Dhabi on 14 November.

items.headline: UFC 333 fight week underway in Abu Dhabi
items.summary: There are two title fights: Volkanovski defends against Evloev, and Yan meets Dvalishvili for a third time. England's Lone'er Kavanagh faces Ramazan Temirov on the main card, which starts at 19:00 Irish time on Saturday.

items.headline: Volkanovski on dismantling Evloev's game plan
items.summary: The featherweight champion says he expects to take away Evloev's usual wrestling-heavy approach.

items.headline: Austin: Antonelli leads by 102 heading into round 19
items.summary: Antonelli (340) leads Russell (238), Hamilton (229) and Verstappen (221) with the title in sight. COTA runs a standard weekend: qualifying at 22:00 Saturday and the race at 20:00 Sunday, Irish time.

items.headline: Austin talking points: Mercedes upgrade, Verstappen's form, Hamilton–Ferrari friction
items.summary: Mercedes need their upgrade to work after a poor Malaysia. Verstappen comes in on two straight wins, and McLaren and Norris are trying to stop a slide.
